results.name: Plan rooms and doors are finite
Coach boarding point is walkable
Every room has an open route and reachable spawn cells
Start, keyboard movement and firing
Pause clears held input and freezes gameplay
Mute control reports its state
Resizing during play updates the touch controls
Focus loss pauses and releases input
A stationary run ends and can restart
Door hold barricades once without firing afterwards
A guest boards the coach and increases the rescue count
Dawn completes a full six-minute clock scenario
Nothing counts as locked in until the porter barricades a door
Opening grabs give a new player time to act
A rescue is counted once
The fictional owner exists and negotiates without affecting rescue totals
Three camera modes preserve controls and can return to top view
Guide follows walkable cardinal cells and toggles
Presentation settings change without changing the simulation state
Detailed rigs preserve outfits when a guest turns
Every room can be traversed to the coach using actual player movement

limits: Actual world and game scripts with real Three.js geometry; renderer, DOM and audio are stubbed. Door and dawn cases use controlled enemy-free scenarios. Browser rendering and real controls require a separate play test.
